SELECT 
    buyer_country,
    CASE 
        WHEN is_island_crossing THEN 'Island-crossing'
        WHEN is_intra_region THEN 'Intra-region'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS lane_type,
    SUM(sum_bwt) / SUM(parcel_qty) AS avg_BWT,
    SUM(sum_apt) / SUM(parcel_qty) AS avg_APT,
    (SUM(sum_bwt) / SUM(parcel_qty)) - (SUM(sum_apt) / SUM(parcel_qty)) AS avg_transit
FROM spx
WHERE is_island_crossing OR is_intra_region
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
